t: An honest description you may recognise
a: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
p: Inna-l-insāna li-rabbihi la-kanūd, wa innahu ʿalā dhālika la-shahīd, wa innahu li-ḥubbi-l-khayri la-shadīd.
m: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful. And indeed, he is to that a witness. And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
